definitions.explanation: A group of people living together as a domestic unit, typically sharing expenses and meals.

examples.japanese: {一人|ひとり}{世帯|せたい}が{増|ふ}えている。
{世帯|せたい}{収入|しゅうにゅう}は{年々|ねんねん}{減少|げんしょう}している。
examples.english: Household income is decreasing year by year.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}から{世帯|せたい}を{持|も}つ{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: I plan to start my own household next year.

notes:
USAGE:
Official/statistical term for counting households:
・{世帯|せたい}{主|ぬし} (head of household)
・{世帯|せたい}{人数|にんずう} (number of people in a household)
・{共働|ともばたら}き{世帯|せたい} (dual-income household)
・{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}{世帯|せたい} (elderly household)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{世帯|せたい}を{持|も}つ (to start a household/get married)
・{世帯|せたい}を{分|わ}ける (to split households)
・{世帯|せたい}{年収|ねんしゅう} (annual household income)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{家庭|かてい} - home, family (more emotional/personal)
・{家族|かぞく} - family (people, not the unit)
